title: Trial conversion with routing uncertainty
prompt: Trial-to-paid conversion fell from 28% to 20%. Revenue leadership blames a pricing-page redesign. Determine why.
facts: Conversion was declining before the pricing-page redesign.
Pricing-page bounce, checkout click-through, and checkout completion were nearly unchanged.
SDR-sourced trials grew from 8% to 37% of trials and convert at 13% versus 29-31% for other sources.
Sales response time rose from 18 to 43 minutes.
Trials with no sales contact within 24 hours increased 19%.
A routing-rules update occurred during week 2, but historical rule versions are missing and 7% of assignment events are absent.
